_doc: Edit timeline of trailer v2, encoded from tools/trailer/CUES_v2.md (the binding contract; the music cue times live in music/cues.py preset 'v2' and edit.py checks this file against it). Times in seconds on the 150.0 s timeline. Read by cards.mjs (text) and edit.py (everything): python3 tools/trailer/edit.py --timeline tools/trailer/timeline_v2.json ... A shot is one or more pieces; each piece shows a clip with a source time pinned to a timeline time ('align': a shots.json key + offset, or 'src' per language), at 'speed', optionally 'crop' [x, y, w] (static zoom, 16:9). 'until' ends a piece (the last one ends with the shot). '_marks' lists the shots.json keys the recorder must produce for that clip.

reuse._doc: v1 clips reused as they are (tools/trailer/reuse_v1.py copies them, marks carried over): new name -> v1 name
